messages:
mara.c: Heads-up — saw ~40 owner flips after the 11:30 surge, opening thread to propose quick mitigation.

jess: likely webhook retries + narrow splay. sample: lead-542 assigned@11:30:11 -> A, 11:30:14 -> B, enrichment arrived 11:30:55.

samir: can we short-circuit rotation if a recent assign exists? maybe an affinity window.

leo.p: propose: add short "sticky_affinity_secs" = 45 for non-vip leads, and increase splay_window to 25s during high qps. VIPs bypass.

ops-bot: prod-telemetry: claim-service 500s 0.2% last 10m; webhook rate peaked at 320/s.

mara.c: config patch draft:
sticky_affinity_secs: 45
splay_window: 25
vip_bypass_tags: ["vip","paid_trial"]

jess: also add idempotency_key header handling in webhook path to dedupe retries for 5s.

samir: test plan: 20m staging replay with 400rps, verify reassigned_count metric drops <1%. then 10% canary for 3h.

leo.p: ops alert: route leads with reassign_count>3 to overflow queue + auto-create ticket.

mara.c: I'll open PR with config toggle + rollout notes. tagging @jess @samir for tests. ETA PR by 2pm.

jess: will add unit tests for idempotency and VIP bypass.

samir: LGTM — thanks team. We'll monitor reassigned_count and owner_affinity_age histograms during canary.

mara.c: thanks — followup in PR comments with smoke results.
